title: 2019 Toyota C-HR Door Panel Repair and Window Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair replaced the missing passenger window and repaired a door panel dent on a 2019 Toyota C-HR in Vancouver, WA.
story: This 2019 Toyota C-HR arrived with the rear passenger door glass broken out and taped over with cardboard, and a sharp crease dent running below the window line.

Carlos stripped the interior door trim to clear the broken glass out of the door cavity and check the components inside, then worked the door skin back to its original body line and sanded, feathered and primed the repair.
A new glass unit went into the door, the panel was sprayed in a white matched to the factory finish, and the door was reassembled and checked to make sure the window ran smoothly again.
